name: PerkDrop
subtitle: Local deals worth knowing
promotionalText: Set your distance. Find free plans, source-checked events and local perks. Discover something worth going out for.
description:
Know what’s worth doing before you make plans.

PerkDrop brings local offers, events, food, experiences and family activities into one place. Choose a suburb or postcode, use Near me, or browse across Australia. Set a search radius from 1 to 200 km and explore your circle on the map.

Make plans faster with shortcuts for free entry, tonight, the weekend and family activities. Suggestions use checked source dates and your saved interests. Quiet areas offer clear wider-search options with distances.

See offers grouped by place, save useful finds and share a public listing with friends. Connect your own devices with a private one-time link to use the same saves, plans and passes. Add an outing to the website planner and export it to your calendar.

Where a business supports a PerkDrop claim, check its availability and conditions before claiming. Not all listings support booking or claiming in the app. A listing is not a booking confirmation.

Listings, dates and availability can change. Always check the official source, booking requirements and any exclusions before you go. Cached offline listings are labelled and cannot issue claims.
reviewNotes: Version 1.1.0 is the native React Native/Expo PerkDrop iPhone app. Native Explore, search/date/category controls, saves, eligible passes and Settings are implemented in the app. The public map and current web detail sheets use trusted https://perkdrop.au WebViews; the website planner uses explicit private-device pairing. Browsing does not require sign-in, payment or a subscription. Saves use a private guest-device credential in secure device storage. Location is optional and requested only after Near me is selected; manual suburb/postcode search remains available. No background location tracking is enabled. New features include the native guide, 1–200 km slider, matching map circle, checked quick plans, saved-interest suggestions and explicit empty-area recovery. Category/date filters remain applied between Explore and the map. Settings includes Delete PerkDrop data with typed confirmation. Remote notifications are optional and require explicit user opt-in; the reviewed release manifest selects the build’s APNs capability, while default EAS profiles keep remote push disabled. Claims appear only for genuinely available merchant inventory; a listing is not a booking confirmation. No native in-app payments or subscriptions are configured. Event facts are source-backed. Imagery is owned, licensed or authorised, with attribution, or an illustrated fallback.
whatsNew:
Your next good plan is closer.

• A fresh local guide with free plans and suggestions inspired by your saves.
• Set your distance from 1–200 km and see your search circle on the map.
• One-tap plans for tonight, the weekend, free entry and family activities.
• Useful wider-area suggestions when your chosen circle is quiet.
• Better local results and clearer explanations of recommended picks.
